rules: Return one JSON object; actions[] for multi-step; mirror first action at top level.
Use input_language for title/notes/append_text; never translate to locale.
Targets: active_task.id, or candidate_tasks only; never invent IDs.
Multiple clock times => one createReminder/createEvent per time in actions[].
Reschedule+note => rescheduleTask then appendToTask on same target.
Reschedule+remind X min before => one rescheduleTask with reminder_offset_minutes=X (not append, not a new task).
改到/改成+time => rescheduleTask; explicit rename phrasing => renameTask.
Ambiguous note vs new reminder => confirmation_kind=clarify.
Times: ISO8601 with offset from current_time+timezone.
examples: 九点…早餐，十一点…接回家 => 2x createReminder
改到两点十分,提前十分钟提醒 => reschedule offset=10
把九点的任务改成十点 => reschedule by hour match
